claim: Completes a full practice game from draft to result
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context; choose three draft cards and three battle choices; assert result screen.

claim: Reset demo starts a new sample draft without changing real room storage
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context with a pre-existing real room token; advance draft; reset; assert Draft 1 and unchanged token.

claim: Practice requests stay on the product origin
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context records every request through the first sample action and asserts same-origin URLs only.

claim: A player can lock a practice draft card with the keyboard
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context focuses a visible card and presses Enter; assert the next draft round appears.

claim: The demo motion setting remains after reload
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context selects Reduced motion, reloads, and asserts the saved selection.

claim: The practice draft uses exactly 18 fixed cards
where: Landing facts and demo draft rule
sandbox: The deterministic practice rules load the shipped card set and assert 18 distinct playable card identities.
Fresh /demo browser context reaches the first card choice without a sign-in form.

claim: The practice game loads without third-party requests
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context records all load requests and asserts each is same-origin.

claim: Makes 2–4 player room codes; two friends can finish a room and start a rematch
where: Landing page, live room table, and README
sandbox: Fresh temporary SQLite service creates and fills 2-, 3-, and 4-player rooms, then two independent tokens draft, battle to a result, and begin a rematch.

claim: Live room picks stay hidden until every player locks one
where: Landing preview, live room table, and room-service README
sandbox: Fresh two-player SQLite room locks one draft pick, observes the other player’s public response, then verifies the next draft releases only after the second lock.

claim: A live room and reconnect token survive a room-service restart
sandbox: Fresh temporary SQLite room is created, its owned service is restarted, and the original token restores the same seat and players.

claim: A battle record uses the chosen card and tactic values to settle its winner
where: Game rules, README, and room-service README
sandbox: Fresh two-player SQLite room completes a draft, submits a visibly higher and lower card/tactic value, and asserts the returned battle record values and winner.

claim: The live room service returns 429 and Retry-After after 60 requests in a minute
sandbox: Fresh temporary SQLite service sends 60 room reads for one forwarded client IP, then asserts the next read is 429 with Retry-After: 60.
